khru res ma reg par bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ de ni bde mchog gi 'khor lo'i dbang du byas pa ste/ sgrub thabs de nyid du/ 'khor lo'i dpangs ni lha so so'i dbu'i steng na yar khru res 'phags pa yin la zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gzhan du na/ lha so so'i zhes pa'i tshig bshad du mi rung ste/ gtso 'khor rnams khru mi mnyam pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang cha chen re la gtso bo'i khru rer bod kyi bla ma rnams bzhed la/ gzhal yas khang gi thog dpangs la cha chen bzhi las med pa'i phyir lha'i sku lus la rang gi khru re las med pa'i skyon yod do// brgyad pa'i sam+bu ṭar/ lus can snying gi dkyil du ni// rtsa rnams lnga ni rnam par gnas// zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs la/ sum skor ma sogs lnga po la ngos 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan ji ltar yin zhes pa ni/ rtsa de lnga la sbas pa'i rtsa lngar nged mi 'dod pas/ de'i rgyu mtshan 'dod mkhan rnams la gsung rgyu yin na'ang*/ 'dir cung zad bshad na/ sam+bu ṭa'i drug pa'i rab byed gnyis par/ mchog tu dga' ba'i ngo bo yis// bya dang byed pa'i dngos po las// rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs kyis ni// 'dir ni ji ltar bde bar rol// 'dab ma rnams kyi gzhi la yang*// 'byung ba bzhi yi rtsa rnams ni// mar me'i rang bzhin lta bur ni// phyogs bzhi la ni rnam par gnas// rtsa rnams bzhi yang mtshams rnams su// rnam par gnas shing des son pa'i// bdud rtsi lnga ni 'bab pa ste// de mchod rang gi gzugs gnas pas// de yi dngos po'i ngo bo las// mchod pa bzhi ni rnam par bshad// lus kyi snying ga'i dkyil du ni// rtsa rnams lnga ni rnam par gnas// zhes pa'i don la/

kha cig sum skor ma sogs nang skor gyi rtsa lnga yin par chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos bshad do zhes zer ba ni ma nges pa ste/ bdag med bstod 'grel las/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga ni gnas snying ga na gnas te/ yang dag par sbyor ba las/ lus can snying gi nang du ni// rtsa rnams lnga ni rnam par gnas// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// bdud 'dral ma ni de dag gi rgyab kyi cha la brten no zhes/ rtsa lnga bdud 'dral ma dang bcas pa sa bcu gsum pa'i sbyang gzhi dang*/ sum skor ma/ 'dod ma/ khyim ma/ gtum mo ste rtsa bzhi'o// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang skor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi las/ phyi skor brgyad du gyes pa'i mtshams nas rlung dang bdud rtsi lnga 'dres pa 'bab pa'i rtsa bzhi po de zhes sa bcu gcig pa'i sbyang gzhir gsungs pa dang 'gal zhing*/ sbyang gzhi rtsa so bdun dang*/ so dang sen mo la sogs pa khams so bdun/ pū dza sogs yi ge so bdun/ de dag sbyong byed du byang phyogs so bdun/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha so bdun/ de dag gi sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi yon tan so bdun sogs rgyu lam 'bras bu gsum chos sum cu so bdun du sbyar ba rnams dgos pa med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// gzhan yang*/ rtsa lnga'i ya gyal bdud 'dral ma yin na/ dpal sa skya pa rnams kyis kyang bdud 'dral ma rtsa lnga'i rgyab kyi cha la gnas par bshad pa dang*/ nā ro pa dang*/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ lce'i dbus su bdud 'dral ma ste// skud pa nag po'i rang bzhin gyis// lce'i rtse mo'i bar du langs pa zhes pa dang 'gal te/ rtsa lnga po snying gi nang du bshad pa'i phyir ro// kha cig dgu pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi la 'dod pa ni rnam par 'khyams te/ sam+pu ṭa las/ rtsa gnyis skyes gnas dbus su ni// g.yon dang g.yas pa'i ngos dag las// g.yon du khu ba rnams shes bya// g.yas pa la ni khrag nyid do// zhes 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi lte ba nas gyes par bshad la/

'dir snying gar yod par bshad pa dang 'gal bas so// des na rang lugs la ro rkyang gnyis las gnyis gnyis su gyes pa dang*/ dbu ma las gcig gyes pa ste lnga yin no// zhes slob dpon chen po bsod nams rtse mos bshad de skyon med pa'i lugs so// dgu pa mnyam sbyor la/ dbyings dang ye shes rgyas gdab phyir/ zhes sogs la so sor sbyar tshul ji ltar bgyid ces pa ni/ dbyings dang rang bzhin gyis dag rgyu dang*/ thig le'i rim phyir dang*/ sems rnams mnyam sbyor la sbyor zhing*/ ye shes dang*/ 'bras phyir dang*/ lus rnams mi mnyam sbyor la sbyor la/ dbang phyir dang*/ dgos pa bsam yas dang*/ rgyas gdab rnams gnyis ka la sbyor te/ bdag gis byas pa'i mngon byang gi gzhi bshad sbas pa'i don gsal du shes par bya'o// bcu pa bskyed rim gyis skye gnas bzhi sbyang bar gsungs na/ mnyam sbyor gyis skye gnas gang sbyang zhes pa ni/ ngag sgros la rdzus skyes dang sgong skyes gnyis sbyang ngo zhes 'chad par snang la/ rje btsun gong mas mngon par rtogs pa zab pa la skye gnas bzhi ka sbyang bar bshad pas/ 'dir gtso bor mngon byang lnga las skyed pa na zla ba 'og ma gsher ba dang*/ gong ma drod yin par rje btsun rtse mos bshad pas drod gsher skyes sbyang la/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams mngal nas 'byin pas mngal skyes/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa thig le'i gong bu las bzhengs pas sgong skyes dang*/ skye mched kyi lha rnams rdzus skyes sbyang bar bzhed do// de ltar dris pa'i don rnams la// rnam par bshad na mtha' yas mod// rgyud dang 'grel pa'i dgongs pa bzhin// nyung ngur bsdus nas gsal bar byas// ding sang chos grwa 'di yi gzhir gnas 'ga'// 'dod pas g.yengs bas don la mi rton zhing*// rgyud 'grel ring spangs chags sdang rang bzor 'chad// than ngan 'byung po'i dmag tshogs 'dus pas na// kho bos legs bshad smra bar mi nus mod// rnam dpyod rgya mtsho'i gling las legs 'ongs pa'i// blo gros nor 'chang dpal ldan lots+tsha ba// rdo rje dpal gyi gsung gis bskul gyur nas// mkhyen rab dbang phyug dpal ldan chos kyi rje// rtog med zhabs kyi gsung las rab skyes pa// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar// de yi dge bas don gnyis grub gyur cig/

༄// slob dpon dge 'dun mgon gyi dris lan bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ skyabs gsum ngo bo mtshungs med chos kyi rje// rtog med mtshan can zhabs la gus btud nas// grogs mchog dam pas ji ltar dris pa'i lan// mdo tsam brjod kyis khyed thugs dgyes par mdzod// de la/ aṃ dang hūm̐ gi rdo rje che// zhes sogs rgyu rdor 'dzin gyi sa bon/ aṃ hūm̐ sngon po zhes sogs 'bras bu rdor 'dzin gyi sa bon du 'chad cing*/ sa bcad de ltar mdzad pa ni// khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni// zhes pa dang 'gal bas/ 'dir sa bcad kyang*/ dang po 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa bon dang*/ phyi ma rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa bon du bsgyur na 'thad do zhes pa ni rigs pa ma yin te/ aṃ dang hūm̐ gi sa bon las bskyed pa'i rgyu rdor 'dzin gyi gzhung dang sbyor ba la/ khu ba'i gzugs las zhes sogs dang mi 'grig pa'i skyon med de/ zhu ba dang khu ba skad dod gcig pas aṃ dang hūm̐ zhu ba las rdor 'dzin yab yum bskyed pa'i don to// yang dang po 'bras bu rdor 'dzin gyi sa bon dang phyi ma rgyu rdor 'dzin gyi sa bon du 'chad pa'ang ches nor te/ 'dir 'khrugs med ces gsungs pa la/ de ltar na 'khrugs can du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ yang gzhung phyi ma rgyu rdor 'dzin la sbyar na/ hūm̐ sngon po zhes gsungs pas sa bon las bskyed pa'i rgyu rdor 'dzin sku mdog sngon por thal ba'i skyon yod la/ 'dod na/ dag ldan las/ 'khor rnams mngal du sa bon/ de las skur gyur te phyogs mtshams su spro ba de'i tshe rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dkar por byas te/ ces dang*/ sa bon bskyed pa'i skabs su sa bon las lha mor gyur te phyir spro ba ni/ gaṃ tsaṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan to zhes pa dang 'gal lo// mngon rtogs bcu bzhi'i dbye ba bdag gis logs su bkod bdog pas der gzigs/

gleng gzhi'i skabs su rgya dpe la snying po med pa ma dag pa ste/ man ngag snye ma las/ glegs bam kha cig las snying po zhes klog pa med de/ 'bri mkhan gyi skyon nyid kyi phyir ro zhes dang*/ de rnams kyi de kho na ni snying po ste zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// 'phar ma gnyis kyi don bshad pa la/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad nyis brtsegs la 'chad pa ni ma yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ shar gyi sgor ni dkar mo chen mo'o// zhes dang*/ rje btsun chen pos/ shar sgor li ces dang*/ shar sgor ni dkar mo'o zhes sogs dang*/ ḍom+bi pas/ yang ni/ shar sgor dkar mo ste/ de bzhin lhor ni chom rkun ma// nub kyi sgo la ro langs ma// zhes dang*/ gnyis med rdo rjes/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dmar po bsams te/ pad+ma'i nang shar phyogs la sogs pa'i 'dab ma bzhi dang*/ de bzhin du gzhal yas khang gi zur bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhi dang*/ steng 'og rnams su ro bco lnga dang ldan par blta bar bya'o// zhes dang*/ de nas phyi rol gyi rim pa la/ dbang po la sogs pa'i mtshams su/ ū ṛ ṝ l̥'i dbyangs la sogs pa'i mi bskyod pa dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag tu med pas rgyas btab pa/ sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung rnams kyi rang bzhin/ puk+ka sī dang*/ sha wa rī dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang*/ ḍom+bī ni rnams bsgom par bya'o// de nas shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su/ l̥̄ e ai o'i dbyangs las byung ba puk+ka sī la sogs pa bzhin du rgyas gdab pa/ gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro rnams kyis rang bzhin du gau rī dang*/ tsau rī dang*/ bai ta lī dang*/ ghasma rī rnams bsgom par bya'o// zhes dang*/ shān+ti pas/ phyi'i grwa mtshams su nyi ma la ū ṛ ṝ l̥'o// shar la sogs pa'i sgo'i nyi ma la l̥̄ i ai au'o// zhes dang*/ mtshams rnams su/ puk+ka sī dang*/ ri khrod ma dang*/ gtum mo dang*/

g.yung mo'o// sgo rnams su chom rkun ma dang*/ ro langs ma dang*/ ghasma rī'o// zhes bshad pas na/ rgyud dang*/ rje btsun gong ma'i man ngag dang*/ rgya gzhung de dag las dkar mo la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad sgo mtshams su dgod par gsungs pa'i phyir 'dab brgyad phyi ma ni don med do// gzhan yang dbang gi chu bor/ 'phar ma gnyis par byed na rdo rje rwa ba sngon po me ri dmar ser du bya/ de nas lha snam shar phyogs kyi sgo dkar po bya/ lho ser po/ nub dmar po/ byang ljang gu/ 'phar ma gcig par byed na pad+ma chen po gcig gis sgo'i bar du khyab par byas nas/ de la rdo rje rwa ba dang*/ me ri byas kyang btub bo// zhes gsungs kyi/ 'phar ma gnyis pa la 'dab brgyad nyis brtsegs byed par ma gsungs so// des na 'phar ma gnyis kyi don ni/ nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'am bzhi pa la rdo rje rwa ba dang me 'od kyis bskor ba/ 'phar ma gcig dang*/ chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i nang du chud pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa ni 'phar ma gcig yin te/ bla ma mnga' ris pa'i tshig 'grel las/ 'phar ma gnyis ni nang na lha mo bdun gyi gnas la rdo rje'i rwa ba me 'od kyis bskor ba/ phyi gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'o// zhes gsungs la/ lha mo bdun gyi gnas zhes pa ni/ bsgom bya'i dbang du byas nas/ gtso bo'i steng 'og tu mkha' spyod ma dang*/ sa spyod ma gnyis te bdun du mngon no// de bzhin du slob dpon mtsho skyes kyang*/ nyis brtsegs ni khang pa nyis rim mo// lte ba yis ni gcig yin te// zhes pa lte bas nye bar mtshon pas pad+ma ni dbus kyi pad+ma zhes pa'i don to// zur gsum gyis ni zhes bya bas ni chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mtshon pas/ rtsegs ma gzhan gyi phyi rol phyi'i gau rī la sogs pa'i gnas gru bzhi'o// zhes dang*/ slob dpon dam tshig rdo rjes/ rim pa gnyis ni rim pa gnyis so// ze'u 'bru las ni gcig yin te/

zhes gsungs pa ni/ dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ni rim pa dang po'o// gru gsum zhes gsungs pa ni gru gsum pa'i nang du chud pa'i gru bzhi pa'o// zhes dang*/ grub thob bha ba bha dras 'phar ma gnyis bstan pa'i bshad pa gsungs pa/ ze'u 'bru las gcig gyur te/ zhes pa la pad+ma la sogs pa las ma gtogs par ni ze'u 'bru 'byung ba ma yin no// des na pad+ma'i ze 'bru zhes man ngag tu ston to// nang gi 'phar mas gcig gyur pa'o// gru gsum gyi ni phyi mar brjod// ces pa ni chos 'byung gi nang du son pa gru gsum gyi rnam pa'i nam mkhar ston pa ni phyi ma ste phyi rol gyi 'phar ma nyid do// de yang gru bzhi pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa ste/ gru bzhi pa la sogs pa ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i thun mong gi mtshan nyid la sogs zhes gsungs pas na/ rgya bod kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po de rnams kyi dgongs pa ni bdag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pas gsal bar mdzad pa ltar yin la/ tshig gi cha de dag kyang bdag nyid chen po bsod nams rtse mo'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer du gsungs pa ltar bris pas na kha na ma tho ba ci yang med do// de'i phyir gzhan gyi blo gros legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho chen po la rang thos chung gi blo gros gzhal bar byed pa ni khron pa'i sbal chung dang mtshungs pa yin no// gal te phyi'i 'phar ma gru bzhi pa dang*/ nang gi 'phar ma pad+ma la 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ nang gi 'phar ma yang dpangs phyi'i 'phar ma lta bu'i gru bzhi pa yin pa la/ de nyid rdo rje phreng ba dang me 'od kyis bskor bas zur rnams bcad pa yin te/ slob dpon sbyang dka' zla bas/ 'phar ma gnyis zhes gsungs pa ni/ kha sbyor lta bu'i 'phar ma ste/ rdo rje phreng bas yongs su bcad pa dang sbas pa'o// zhes gsungs la/ kha sbyor ni gru bzhi pa yin te/

rin chen 'bar ba las/ kha sbyor gcig pa sgo bzhi pa// zhes dang*/ de'i 'gyur kha cig las/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ gal te kha sbyor dang 'phar ma dang*/ rim pa sogs ni pad+ma la bya'i gru bzhi pa la bya ba ni ma yin no zhe na/ de la ni sngar bshad pa'i lung de rnams kyis kyang gnod la/ rgyud las kyang*/ 'phar ma gcig dang sgo bzhi pa// zhes yab kyi skabs su gsungs pa de yang pad+ma 'dab brgyad la 'chad par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do// 'dod na gzhung de yi rjes kho na la/ de dbus pad+ma 'dab ma ni// brgyad pa ze bar bcas pa bri// zhes pa'i gzhung gong 'og la dpyad pa ma zhugs par zad la/ dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i gzhung gzhan las/ bde gshegs 'phar ma zhes gru bzhi pa la gsungs pa rnams kyang ma mthong ba yin no// yang steng 'og gi lha mo gnyis bsgom pa'i tshe/ gtso bo'i steng 'og tu bsgoms la/ mtshan ma dgod pa'i tshe gang du 'bri na/ lots+tsha ba kha cig sam+bu ṭa las/ srid dang zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis// ngos su bsgyur ma 'di dag gnas// zhes dang*/ de nyid gsum gyi rang bzhin bdag /mkhas pas dbus su bsgom par bya// zhes gsungs pas gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon du bri zhes smra mod kyi/ gzhung de bsgom bya'i skabs su/ gtso mo'i steng 'og tu bskyed par bstan pa yin gyi bri bya'i skabs ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis kyang*/ 'dir man ngag gi ro langs ma'i mtshan ma dang nye bar sa spyod ma'i 'o// phyi'i gau ri'i mtshan ma dang nye bar mkha' spyod ma'o// zhes dang*/ dkyil chog rdo rje phreng bar/ mkha' spyod ma'i mtshan ma ni dkar mo'i phyi ngos su'o// ro langs ma'i phyi ngos su ni sa spyod ma'i 'o// zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ rgya bod kyi bla ma gong ma gang gis kyang*/ de lta bur ma bshad pa'i phyir mun sprul kho na yin la/ sam+bu ṭa'i lung shes byed du 'dren pa'ang sna bcad ma g.yar po'i rgyan chas mdzes par byed pa dang mtshungs so// des na lha mo 'di gnyis kyi mtshan ma steng gi shar sgo dang*/

'og gi nub sgor 'god pa phyag len yin zhing*/ rje btsun rtse mo dang*/ ne tso sbal ston sogs kyis kyang bshad do// gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par zhes sogs la/ lots+tsha ba kha cig rgyas par brtag pa bcu gnyis kyis// gong mar gsungs pa mdo ru bsdu// zhes pa'i gzhung du snang ste/ 'di brtag pa sum cu'i 'og ma yin pas so gnyis pa 'di nas yar bcu gnyis pa bgrangs pa'i gong ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ yas mar bgrangs pa'i dgu pa ni/ ku ru kul+le'i brtag pa yin te/ gur las/ mkha' 'gro ku ru kul+le dgu// zhes pa dang 'grig go zhes 'chad pa ni nor ba ste/ gzhung de brtag pa so gcig pa nas 'byung ba la/ so gnyis pa nas bgrangs pa don med pa'i phyir dang*/ de nyid kyis brtag pa bcu gnyis par yang bsgrub nus te/ so gnyis pa nas bgrangs pa'i bcu tshan gnyis kyi gong ma brtag pa bcu gnyis yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'gyur de las bcu gnyis kyi gong mar zhes 'byung gis/ bcu gnyis pa gnyis kyi gong mar zhes mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// des na rje btsun sku mched kyi rnam bshad gnyis su dngos grub brtag pa bcu gnyis pa kho na la gsung zhing*/ slob dpon dam tshig rdo rjes/ brtag pa bcu gnyis zhes bya ba ni/ dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud rgyas pa'i brtag pa bcu gnyis las so// zhes dang*/ ḍaṃ ka dha shas/ sngon du kye rdo rje 'bum phrag lnga pa'i bdag nyid du brtag pa bcu gnyis kyi rgyas par gsungs pa de/ da ni mdor bsdus la bshad par bya'o// zhes bshad pa ltar don la gnas so// gal te de ltar na/ gur las dgu par bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ dgu pa nas/ ku ru kul+le'i dkyil 'khor ston la/ bcu gnyis pa nas thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i las ston to// zhes bla ma mnga' ris pa'i 'grel par bshad do// sngags mtshan nyid 'bras bu mnyam por 'dod na/ sngags kyi 'bras bu bcu gsum pa ma yin par 'gyur te/

gnyis ka'i 'bras bu la khyad med cing*/ bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa la bzhugs pa yin pa'i phyir ro// gal te sngags kyi 'bras bu yang sa bcu gsum pa yin te/ de'ang phar phyin pa'i sa bcu la gsum du phye ba'i sa bcu pa tsam ni bcu pa/ khyad par gyi lam ni bcu gcig pa/ bar chad med pa'i lam ni bcu gnyis pa/ kun tu 'od ni bcu gsum pa'o// yang na sa bcu'i steng du/ tshogs sbyor gnyis bsnan pas bcu gsum yin no// zhe na ma yin te/ sam+bu ṭa las/ pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams la// rnal 'byor ma rnams kla klo'i skad// zhes sogs kyi sa bcu man chad pha rol du phyin pa dang mtshungs par bshad la/ phar phyin nas 'di lta bu'i rnam gzhag mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ de ltar na'ang phar phyin pa'i 'bras bu'ang sa bcu gsum par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ tshogs lam las dang po pa'i sa dang*/ sbyor lam mos pa spyod pa'i sa gnyis thob pas/ sangs rgyas brgya mthong ba la sogs pa/ dang po'i yon tan rnams mi skye ba'i phyir dang*/ phar phyin pa'i tshogs lam gsang sngags pa'i sa dang po yin na/ yul bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar thim dgos pa las der thim pa med pa'i phyir ro// gal te thim pa srid do zhe na/ mi srid de/ der thim na mjug tu thim rgyu med pa la/ der ma thim pas sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin thob kyang*/ rlung stong brgyad brgya ma 'gags shing*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba stong brgyad brgya ma rdzogs pas/ spangs rtogs lhag ma dang bcas pa phyag na rdo rjes bde mchog stod 'grel du bshad do// zhes pa 'di yang slob dpon dge 'dun mgon gyis dris pa'i lan du/ thams cad mkhyen pa rtog med zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos chos grwa chen po dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// a mo gha'i dris lan bzhugs so// ༈ /na maḥshrī gu ra we/ dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrubs thabs kyi ṭī ka'i skabs gyi dogs spong cung zad brjod na/

dri ba dang po gzhal yas khang gi dpangs kyi tshad kyi skabs su/ nang gi ka ba cha chen bzhi yin pa'i sgrub byed du/ de nyid snang chen gyi lung la brten nas/ lte ba nas rdo rje'i thig gi bar thal por btab la/ ka ba'i ring thung dang sbom phra'i tshad du mdzad gsungs pa/ rtsa thig nas tshangs thig gi bar la cha chen bzhi yod kyang rtsa thig nang nas zlum por bskor ba'i gdung thig gi nang nas lte ba'i bar la cha chen bzhi mi yong bas/ ji ltar bzhed gsungs pa la/ de ltar na rta babs dpangs su sgo tshad gcig ma'i tshe/ dbus ra'i rings su cha phran gnyis par 'gyur te/ mda' thig nas gdugs kyi phyi thig bar la cha chen gnyis yod kyang*/ chos 'khor gyi 'og gi dbus rwa'i mthongs sa la cha phran gnyis las med pa'i phyir ro// gal te de ni/ dbus rwa rnams bri bya la/ rta babs kyi 'og tu non pas ma mthong ba yin gyi/ bsgom bya la cha chen gnyis yod do snyam na/ 'dir yang mtshungs te/ bri bya la gdung zlum gyi thig gi 'og tu non pa yin pas/ bsgom bya la cha chen bzhi med pa'i skyon med do// des na ka ba cha chen bzhir nges pa 'di/ de nyid snang chen dang*/ ko sa la'i rgyan gnyis ka'i dgongs par mchis so// dri ba gnyis pa/ 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i dpangs la cha chen gcig tu bzhed gsungs pa/ rwa dbus ma'i dpangs kyang de las chad pa yong don med pas/ rwa nyi shu pa'i tshe/ steng 'og gi rwa'i skye sa dang chags tshul ji ltar bzhed/ yang rwa rnams phyi nang du ni mi bzhed las che/ gal te bzhed na bri bya'i dus de mthun gyi thig dgos na yang*/ de 'dra ni med pa 'dra bas ji ltar mdzad gsungs pa la/ lte ba'i dpangs la/ 'dod tshul med 'dra ba mang du yod pa ṭī kar bkod zin la/ rang lugs la/ slob dpon shān+ti pa'i rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs su stegs bur bshad pa la brten nas/ dpangs cha chen gcig tu 'dod/

de'i tshe rwa rtse bcu gnyis pa la dogs pa med kyang*/ rtse mo nyi shu pa'i tshe steng 'og tu skyes yod med kyi dogs pa 'khrungs pa shin tu mod/ 'on kyang rdo rje phreng bar thig gi skabs su/ sna tshogs rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyogs la ni/ rwa'i 'gram du rwa gzhan dag go /zhes rwa sbrag ma bri bar bshad pa ltar/ bsgom bya la'ang de ltar du 'dod lags/ gal te de bri bya yin gyi bsgom bya la rwa gnyis steng 'og tu dgos kyi/ de lta ma yin na/ rdo rjer ma song ngo snyam na/ 'o na slob dpon la li ta badz+ra'i lugs kyi dgra nag gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'jigs lta nyi shu 'joms pa dag pas/ rwa nyi shu pa'i dbus su gtso bo phyogs kyi rwa bzhi la gti mug gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa bzhi 'god par bshad pa de/ dbus rwa'i rtse mo gug pa'i 'og tu ni lha mi shong*/ rwa la 'god par ni bshad/ steng rwa'i steng du mi rta la zhon pa ltar yang khas len mi nus pas/ rwa gnyis phyi nang las 'os med pa lags/ de bzhin du slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi dkyil 'khor la/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshams kyi rwa bzhi la khro bo bzhi 'god par bshad pa dang yang mthun par mchis so// dri ba gsum pa/ bdag med ma lta bu 'og tu lha snam dgos pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba lha snam dang bcas pa la dpangs cha chen lhag tsam las ma byung bas/ 'og gi lha dkyil 'khor de'i lhar nges par bzhed dgos tsa na/ de'i bskyed sa gang du mdzad gsungs pa la/ spyir 'di la dgag sgrub rgyas par bya dgos na'ang*/ re zhig rang lugs la/ lha snam gyi dbus su pad+ma gyen du 'phag pa'i yu ba la cha phran bdun yod pa de'i mdun/ dbus kyi sa gzhi'i steng du 'og gi lha bsgom pa lags/ de'i steng du mi shong ba'i skyon med de/ bdag gi lugs la/ khang bzangs kyi nang gi thog dpangs kyi tshad cha phran so gnyis su 'dod pas so// de ltar bshes gnyen dam pas dris pa'i lan// rings shing shin tu mgyogs par phul ba 'di// gus dang g.yar khral 'tshal bar bya phyir te// slar yang ci nus legs bshad sgrogs par smon//
//shu bhaṃ// //

༄// chen po chos rin gyi dris lan bzhugs so// ༈ /rigs rus cho 'brang rnam par dag cing*/ 'khor dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs la/ mthu stobs dang byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa drung bla ma chen po'i drung du/ dge slong rgyal khams pas zhu ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug khyed nyid sku khams bzang zhing*/ rim gnyis zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la brtson pa mi lhod par bzhugs pa'i ngang nas gsung shog gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas pa bskur ba rnams/ bla ma pas 'phrod pas thugs la btags shing rjes su yi rangs lags/ slad nas sngags 'chang dam pa khyed nyid/ bstan pa rin po che dang 'gro ba mang po'i don du yun ring du bzhugs par gsol zhing*/ de ltar gyur cig pa'i smon lam yang rtse gcig tu 'debs pa lags/ tshogs 'khor sogs kyi zhal ta rnams la/ zhu ba mdor bsdus te phul na/ tshogs 'khor byed mkhan gyi gang zag de/ dge slong sogs rab byung yin nam rnal 'byor pa yin/ 'di gnyis las mi 'da' lags/ dang po ltar na/ tshogs rdzas la/ tshim tshim du longs mi spyod pa de/ chos rje'i dgongs pa yin par khyed rang gi'ang zhal gyis bzhes tshar/ de'i phyir 'o skol rnams chos gos 'dzin pa'i rab byung lags mod/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rang rgyud la ye shes rgyas pa'i thabs su tshogs 'khor lkog tu bya ba dang*/ gdul bya gzhan ma dad pa bzlog pa'i phyir dngos su byed pa gnyis las ma 'das/ dang po ltar na/ bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis tha mal gyi snang zhen 'gog nus pa cig dgos par/ chos rjes dpe dang bcas te gsungs/ 'di lta bu'i yon tan bdag cag la med do// rang re'i gsung yig na tha mal gyi snang zhen med pa dang*/ rdzas la dag ma dag gi rtog pa ma spangs pa'i tshogs 'khor byed mkhan su yod gsung gda' ba/ de lta bu'i yon tan yod na skyabs su mchi/ 'on kyang yon tan 'di thob par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i sngags 'chang rnams tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i drung du lug sha bzang po cig dang*/

khyi sha rul pa cig phul na bzang ngan gyi rtog pa 'dug mi 'dug mngon sum gyis grub mchis/ gnyis pa ltar na/ gzhan gsang sngags la mi mos pa bzlog pa'i don du/ skye bo mang po'i dbus su dri chen la sogs pa ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams dag pa'i rdzas su dngos su bsgyur nas gzhan gyi ma dad pa dngos su bzlog nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen pos byed par bshad kyi/ de rnams mi nus pas byed par ma bshad gda'/ des na bdag gis nyan thos kyi sgor zhugs pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor pa la so thar gang rung gi sgor zhugs pa cig nges par dgos pa don la gnas shing*/ rje yab sras kyis gsung rab nas 'byung la/ rnal 'byor pa che chung gnyis ka'i yon tan gang dang yang mi ldan zhing*/ rten chos gos 'dzin par song bas rang gi rgyud tshod dang mthun pa'i spyod pa nyams su blangs pa lags/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang gnyis pas/ dge tshul lam/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pas 'dul ba nas bshad pa'i dge tshul gyi bslab bya bcu blang 'das dang bcas pa dang*/ dge slong gi ltung ba sde lnga po rnams la kun slong khyad gsod kyi blos dpyad na/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pas me la reg na bla med kyi rtsa ltung gnyis par 'gyur zhing*/ khyad gsod med par spyad na/ yan lag gi ltung bar 'gro bar bshad pa 'di ma nges pa ni mi srid mchi/ yang dar paṇa gyi grub mtha' mchog tu 'dzin pa dang*/ rje sa skya pa'i grub mtha' rang lugs su khas len pa gnyis mi 'gal lags sam/ rje btsun gyis/ nyan thos kyi dge slong sngags kyi sdom ldan la dge slong rdo rje 'dzin par bshad gda' 'am/ mchog dbang gsum thob pa la dge slong rdor 'dzin du bshad gda'/ he he/ yang rang re pas/ gos dmar lus la dkris pa dpal ldan bla ma min/ zhes pa shes byed 'thad ldan du drangs gda' ste/ de ltar na/ drung pa rang yang der thal/ de'i phyir/ mdor na 'dul ba dang*/

gsang sngags tsha reg dang grang reg bzhin du 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' 'di/ rje sa skya pa/ 'khrul zad lnga char gyi gsung rab dang 'gal zhing*/ bstan pa spyi la gnod pas bka' bskyon chen po 'di mi gsung ba drung nas mkhyen mkhyen/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gis/ rgyal ba ngas gsungs so sor thar pa yi// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa ma lus la// sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cha lugs spang*// lhag ma rnams ni nyams su blang bar bya// zhes bka' stsal pa 'di ma bsnyel ba thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ yang drung pa'i gsung yig tu/ tha mal pa'i 'khrig pa dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gnyis ngo 'phrod ma 'phrod ma gtogs pa khyad par med gsungs pa 'di/ byang chub sgrub pa la gegs byed pa'i nor pa chen po lags pas/ bdag gi zhu yig 'di slebs phyin chad grub mtha' 'di zhal nas 'don pa lta zhog thugs la yang skad cig tsam yang mi 'chang bar zhu lags/ 'di yi rgyu mtshan/ dbang po gnyis byung bde ba ni/ de nyid yin zhes skye ngan smra'i// de yi de nyid bde chen du// rgyal ba mchog gis ma gsungs so// zhes lung du drangs nas dgag pa yang yang mdzad pa ma gzigs lags sam/ grub mtha' 'di/ mu stegs kyi gsang sngags pa rnams kyi 'dod pa yin par slob dpon mai tri pas bshad gda' zhing*/ bod du/ rngog chos rdor bzhed pa la/ rje sa skya pa rnams kyis bkag pa de lags mod/ spyir deng sang gi sngags pa rnams kyis mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang*/ 'dzag pa'i bde ba gnyis shan mi phyed par gda'/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin na/ rgyu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba las byung bas khyab lags mod/ he he/ sngags rnying ma'i chos skor kun la/ dgag sgrub kyi dgos pa chung bar gda' zhing*/ bdag sngags rnying ma la sdang zhen de tsam mi che/ 'di dag 'di mi dag sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bris gda' bas des khyab lags/ chos skyong dang gshin rje gshed kyi gdams ngag skor la phyis kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig gis/

rnying ma'i mdos/ bskang ba/ zor sogs/ gsar ma'i rgyud 'grel na brda chad tsam yang med pa mang po bsnan gda' ba/ mngon sum gyis grub pa de lags mod/ slad mar sku khams rin po che bzang zhing thugs dam 'gro don rgya che ba'i ngang nas/ bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/ bye brag tu rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas kyi thabs la/ sngar bzhin du brtson pa mi 'dor ba thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ gdan sar slebs nas zhu yig cig 'bul bar bgyi/ nyer drug la phul ba dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ sadhu// // ༄// gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyis dris lan bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra ba ra hī/ mi g.yo bla med kyi rgyud/ lots+tsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ bud med la dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ bud med gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa yum lngar bskyed pa la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba sogs khyad par mang du bshad gda' ba rnams rgyud de nyid du gzigs pas 'tshal bar mchis/ 'on kyang mi g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor du bud med la dbang bskur na yin gyi/ gzhan du 'di'i rigs mthun sbyar du mi rung*/ dbang gsum pa'i skabs su/ bud med la thabs gtad par bsgom pa/ slob dpon bi bhū ti tsan+d+ras bshad gda'/ gzhan rgyud rnams las skyes pa dang*/ bud med la rdo rje'i ming tha dad du bshad pa tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan gsal bar bshad pa ma mthong lags/ zhes pa dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod nas phul ba dge/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// bsam grub rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ dam pa'i chos la sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa/ bla ma bsam grub rgyal mtshan pa thugs dam 'phel ba'i thad nas gsung yig ras phrugs bzang po'i rten bcas 'dir 'phrod pas sems shin tu spro/ de la khyed kyi dri ba dang po spyir bstan pa'i lam gyi 'gro tshul gang yin gsung ba/ thog mar mdo sde nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon cig gi drung du/

chos snying nas byed 'dod kyi slob ma cig lhags pa na/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang*/ mi rtag pa'i gtam gyis tshe 'di'i sred pa don gnyer gyi blo bzlog par byas/ de'i 'og tu las rgyu 'bras la yid ches khyad par can bskyed pa'i gtam gyis rgyu 'bras la blang dor tshul bzhin du byed cing yid ches su bcug de'i 'og tu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi gtam gyis 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can/ bde ba dang snying po cung zad tsam yang med par shes pas 'khor ba la yid 'byung nas skyabs kyi dam pa/ dkon mchog gsum la zhe thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ de'i bslab bya la tshul bzhin du slob tu gzhug de nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can de spangs la/ thar pa bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob par byed dgos shing*/ sangs rgyas de'ang rgyu med rkyen med las mi 'grub pas/ rgyu snying rje chen po dang*/ rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems dang*/ rkyen thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa ste/ 'di gsum du theg chen gyi lam thams cad 'dus par shes nas thabs 'di gsum la brtson pa drag pos nan tan du bslabs pas/ lam lnga dang sa bcu rim can du bgrod nas/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyi mthar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba lags/ yang gang zag blo gros chen po 'ga' zhig skye ba 'di la sangs rgya bar 'dod na/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam la nges par 'jug dgos la/ de'i tshul yang rkyen thabs la mkhas pa la bslab tshul yan chad sngar bzhin legs par bslabs nas/ de'i rjes su rdo rje slob dpon rgyud nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid can btsal la/ de mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas nas/ dad pas gsol ba btab/ de'i 'og tu/ bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams kyi smin grol rim pa bzhin bslabs nas rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam la 'jug pa'am/ yang na bla ma mnyes par byas pa'i 'og tu rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam la zhugs kyang rung*/

de'ang thog mar bde kye gsang gsum mam/ dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde tshad ldan nas bshad pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs la/ dbang yongs su rdzogs par blang*/ de dus thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom nan tan du bya/ dam tshig dag pa'i rten des bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs par bsgoms nas tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyangs/ de'i 'og tu rdzogs rim rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pas rlung dbu mar zhugs te/ lhar snang bde ba chen po spros pa dang bral ba'i de kho na nyid rtogs nas sngar gyi lam lnga dang*/ sa bcu nang ting nge 'dzin gyi dus myur du bgrod nas skye ba 'di la rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa yin/ tshul 'di nyung ngus gtan la phebs mi nus pas/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung dri ma med pa rab 'byams la sbyang dgos shing*/ de tsam mi nus na dge ba'i bshes gnyen phrin las pa chen po'i bstan rim dang*/ slob dpon phywa pa'i rgyal sras 'jug ngogs dang*/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i rgyal sras lam bzang rnams la sbyang ba yun ring du byas na/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam spyi'i gnad rtogs par 'gyur zhing*/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing dang*/ rje 'gos kyi gsang 'dus kyi stong thun dang*/ bla ma 'bro ba'i dus 'khor gyi 'od zer phreng ba dang*/ grub chen sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi zhal lung rtsa 'grel rnams la thos bsam yun ring du mdzad pas rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi 'jug tshul rnams rdzogs par 'gyur ba lags/ dri ba gnyis pa/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gang yin zhes pa la/ spyir mang yang*/ 'dir kye rdo rjer/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid// ces pa'i rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi gzhi/ rkang pa 'og ma'i phyed dang pos lam/

phyed 'og mas 'bras bu rnams bstan te/ rgyu rgyud rang gi sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid de la/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha nas sangs rgyas su btags nas gsungs pa yin gyis/ stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyis yon tan rnams yod nas sangs rgyas su bzhag pa ma yin/ thabs rgyud glo bur gyi dri ma de sel ba'i thabs smin grol gyi ting nge 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa la zer ba yin/ 'bras rgyud lam bsgoms pas glo bur gyi dri ma rnams yon tan du gnas gyur nas sku bzhi mngon du gyur pa la zer bar gda'/ dri ba gsum pa gsang sngags kyi lta sgom spyod pa'i rnam bzhag gang yin ces pa la/ yul dngos po'i gnas lugs spros pa dang bral bar 'chad pa la mdo sngags gnyis la khyad par med pas dbu ma nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ sngags kyi theg par yang bskyar te 'chad pa ma gtogs gzhan khyad par med/ 'on kyang lta ba de yul can rnal 'byor pa'i blo la ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa dang*/ rtogs nas goms par byed pa la gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags pa yin/ bsgom pa rgyud sde 'og ma gsum ltar na mtshan bcas mtshan med dam/ rnal 'byor bla med ltar na/ rim gnyis 'khor bcas la zer/ spyod pa spyir so thar gyi spyod pa 'dul ba dang mthun/ byang sems kyi mdo sde dang mthun/ gsang sngags rgyud sde dang mthun dgos kyi/ sdom pa gsum gang dang yang mi mthun pa'i rtsing spyod bya mi nyan/ bye brag tu gsang sngags la khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ rab byung rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis las/ dang po rang gis khas blangs pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa dang*/ der ma zad gzhan yang*/ rtags 'dzin pa ma gtogs pa'i so thar rnams bsrung dgos par bshad de/ dpung bzang las/ rgyal ba des gsungs so sor thar pa yi// dam tshig dang ni 'dul ba ma lus la// sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cha lugs spang*// lhag ma rnams ni nyams su blang bar bya// zhes gsungs la/

rab byung rdo rje 'dzin pa ltar na/ rtswa gcod pa dang*/ sa rko ba sogs so thar dang 'gal ba'i ltung ba phra mo byung ba la/ kun slong khyad gsod kyis blo yod na gsang sngags kyi rtsa ltung gnyis par 'gyur zhing*/ khyad gsod kyi blo med na bcad tsam gyi yan lag gi ltung bar 'gyur bas rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis so thar gyi sdom pa 'dul 'dzin rab re bsrung dgos/ byang sems kyi sdom pa khyim pa dang rab byung gi rdor 'dzin gang yin kyang rung ste/ rigs lnga spyi'i bsdus pa'i dam tshig yin pa'i phyir nges par bsrung dgos pa lags/ dri ba bzhi pa/ phyag rdzogs dbu ma gsum la lta ba mtho dman gyi khyad par yod dam med ces pa la/ rdzogs chen la/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang*/ rje 'gos/ nya dbon kun dga' sogs kyis gzhung rnam dag min gsungs pa'i dgag pa mtha' yas pa mdzad gda' zhing*/ phyag chen la/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ blun pos phyag rgya che bsgom pa// phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru zad// ces sogs gsung gda'/ nged kyis phyag rdzogs gnyis ka la sbyang pa ma byas pas bzang ngan ci 'dra yod mi shes lags/ dbu ma chos thams cad kyi snying po yin pas/ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa btsal nas de nyams su len pa las 'thad pa gzhan mi yong*/ dri ba lnga pa/ sdom gsum bslab pa 'gal ba nang thug pa rnams ji ltar bsrung zhes pa la/ gang zag las dang po pa'i dus su so thar gtso bor bya/ brtan pa cung zad thob nas/ byang sems gtso bor bya/ brtan pa cher thob te/ rnam shes dang ye shes kyi las mnyam nas rnal 'byor bar gyur pa'i tshe/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa gtso bor bya/ mdor na/ bstan pa rin po che la gang phan dang*/ rang gi rgyud tshod dang bstun pa'i spyod pa gcig bya dgos kyi 'di gtso mtha' gcig tu nges pa med/ nged kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus shig bskur gsung ba/ dkon mchog gsum la zhe nas skyabs su 'gro zhing*/

mdo sde mdzangs blun la snying nas dad pa rnyed pa tsam ma gtogs gzhan yon tan gyi khyad par gang yang med/ bla ma bsten tshul sogs mjal dus gleng bas khyab/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i chos skor rnams nged kyis ma thob lags/ spyir rang re thugs rab phun sum tshogs pa yod par gda' bas/ phar phyin dang*/ 'dul ba cig la ci nas kyang gsan sbyong mdzad pa drag pas de bzhin mdzad du gsol/ nyer bdun la brag dkar dgon pa nas dge legs 'phel// //shu bhaṃ// //

༄// slob dpon bsam bzang gi dris lan bzhugs so// ༈ /slob dpon bsam bzang gi zhus lan la/ sbyong rgyud du rang rang gi mchod rten dang*/ rang gi lha'i sku la dbang bskur zhes pa/ gshin po'i rus pa la byas pa'i tsha tsha dang*/ par sku btab pa sogs la dbang bskur ba lags/ dbang bskur dus mchod rten dang*/ lha sku gang yin kyang rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pas khyab/ ming 'dzin pa la dbang bskur na ming 'dzin pa de la tshe 'das kyi don du dbang bskur byed pa lags/ gshin chog mi dgos/ ro bsregs pa'i sngon du sbyang ba nas skyabs 'gro'i bar gyi gshin chog sngon du song nas ro rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa la/ dbang bskur rdzogs par byed dbang tshar ba dang*/ ro thab khung du sbyin sreg gi tshul du bsregs pa lags/ bla ma dang dge bshes sogs kyi gdung sbyangs na gdung de dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ji lta ba bzhin du byas pas khyab/ yon bdag gi tshul du sbyangs na thab kyi dbus su dkyil 'khor bskyed/ ro de bsreg rdzas sna tshogs par bsams nas sbyin sreg byed/ kye rdor gyi dus tha ma ltar lus kyi yan lag so so la 'bul ba rnams 'dir mi dgos/ yum chen mo ser mo phyag bzhi ma gzhung gang na 'dug ma mthong*/ bka' gdams dar yul ba'i sman lha'i mchod chog na bris snang*/ phyis chos rje rgyal sras pas kyang de bzhin mdzad gda'/ gzhan ma mthong*/ 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa de gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs yin bdag bskyed la de bsgoms nas/ bum bzlas mdun bskyed lha sta gon rnams la ro langs brgyad bskor phyag mtshan dang bcas pa bskyed pa/ phyag len dang bcas pa gnyis ka la bdog bdag bskyed la ro langs brgyad bskyed pa ma dag bdag mdun gnyis ka la yum byed pa shin tu ma dag dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor thugs dkyil bris/

cho ga thams cad yongs rdzogs ltar rgyas par bya/ bye brag tu mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i tshe thugs dkyil dngos su bskyed/ gsung dkyil man chad blos sprul nas bskyed pas cho ga rnam par dag par 'gyur te/ rgyud du dbang gi don du rigs kyi dbang gi phyi rol dkyil 'khor dag ni rab tu dman pa nyid du 'gyur/ zhes gsung*/ de'i don gsung dkyil man chad kyi lha rigs can yin cing*/ thugs dkyil gyi lha rnams rigs bdag yin pa'i phyir/ thugs dkyil gyi lha'i nang du gzhan thams cad 'dus par bstan pa yin zhes chos rje phyogs pa'i yig char 'byung*/ kun spangs chen po'i dngos slob chos rje brag kha ba grags pa seng ge'i phyag len la yang de ltar mdzad kyin yod gda' bas shin tu dag pa lags// // ༄// dbu ma pa la gdams pa bzhugs so// ༈ /sid+dhiḥbha wan+tu/ rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mdo// gang gi blo yi rgya mtshor legs gtams shing*// sna tshogs shes bya'i de nyid snang ba can// bshes gnyen dbu ma pa la 'di skad 'doms// yo ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi dbang bskur ba spyi'i rnam gzhag la/ slob ma sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la gsol btab dang*/ rna ba gtad par skul ba sogs sngon du 'gro bas gnas bzhi byin gyis brlab pa/ dngos gzhi/ srung skud/ so shing sogs mtha' brten du byas pa'i sta gon rdzogs par byas nas/ dngos gzhi la 'jug pa dang dbang bskur ba gnyis kyi/ dang po dkyil 'khor bstan pa yan chad dang*/ gnyis pa dbang la/ rdo rje slob mar dbang bskur ba dang*/ slob dpon du dbang bskur ba las/ dang po me tog gang phog gi rten la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs rnams bskur/ gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rten la rnal 'byor chen po'i lha rnams bkod pa la dam tshig gsum sbyin/ de'i mtha' brten du mig thur dang me long sogs sbyin pa yo ga'i dbang yongs rdzogs kyi cho ga'i lugs yin pa ltar/

yo ga smad lugs kyi bla ma rnams kun rig la'ang dbang gi rnam gzhag de ltar bzhed na'ang*/ 'dir yo ga stod lugs kyi bla ma rnams sbyong rgyud kyi dngos bstan tsam las kha skong mang po mi mdzad kyang*/ don sngar gyi yo ga spyi'i rnam bzhag rnams tshang bar yod pa yin te/ de la rgyun bshags bya ba nas/ srung ba'i bar slob ma sta gon/ gdong g.yogs pa nas dam tshig phog pa'i bar 'jug pa'i cho ga de nas rdo rje slob mar dbang bskur ba la sngags dbang*/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs rnams 'byung ba las/ sngags bcu gsum brjod pa sngags dbang*/ rigs lnga'i bum pas dbang bskur ba/ dang po chu dbang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya/ rin chen cod paṇa/ dar dpyangs dang gsum ster ba gnyis pa/ cod paṇa gyi dbang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang*/ phyag mtshan gyis yu ba byas pa'i dril bu ster ba gsum pa rdo rje'i dbang dang*/ bzhi pa dril bu'i dbang*/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba dang rdo rje zhes bya ba nas las zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro// zhes rigs lnga char gyi mtshan nas brjod pa ming gi dbang ste rig pa'i dbang lnga dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje ster ba rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi slob ma'i dbang ngo*// de nas chos 'khor lag tu gtad pa'am/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas gtugs pas/ slob ma bh+rūm̐ dang 'khor lo las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnam snang du bsgom pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba lnga'i dbang ster ba/ phyag chen sku'i dam tshig gzung ma lnga'i dbang ster ba/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan ster ba rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig 'di la phyag mtshan phra mo mtheb srin gyi 'og tu sbas nas bskur ba'i phyir gsang dbang zhes kyang gdags/ de ltar dam tshig gsum byin pas slob dpon du gyur to zhes rdo rje dril bu lag tu gtad pas chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang*/ de ltar dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i mtha' rten du rin chen sna bdun dang bka'i dbang bskur ba rnams byed pas lugs 'di la yo ga che ba'i dbang gi don rnams tshang mar bzhugs pas/

gzhan gyi cho ga mang po kha bskang mi dgos shing*/ dbang gi rnam gzhag de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dbang chog gi tshigs bcad rnams la dpyad pas rtogs par 'gyur ba lags/ cho ga'i don la dpyad pa mdzad pa shin tu ngo mtshar che/ da dung de bzhin mdzad du gsol/ zhes e waṃ ri khrod nas phul ba dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ // ༄/ rat+na shrī la springs pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ gang gi tshul khrims rnyog pa'i dri bral zhing*// mngon lkog med pa'i rnam dag spyod pa can// zob brdzu'i gting skyon rdul tsam mi mnga' ba// mkhas pa'i dbang po g.yag ston chos rje rgyal// de yis rjes bzung sras kyi thu bo pa// thub bstan rin chen rgyas pa'i khur cher zhing*// gzhung lugs rab 'byams rtogs pa'i dpal yon can// bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i mchog la 'di skad gsol// 'tsho zhing bzhes la chos kyang ston pa'i thad nas gsung yig gnang ba/ ka bcu pa dkon bzang nas brgyud de 'phrod pas sems shin tu spro/ 'dir yang dkon mchog gi bka' drin las/ skyabs 'gro 'phel bar mchis/ skabs zhus/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis/ nyin rer rdo rje'i slob ma la// mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya// bshang gci sha yi bya ba dang*// rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig dag gis// sngags rnams kun gyi yi ge oṃ// bsgoms na de ma thag tu 'bar// zhes bka' stsal zhing*/ de'i 'grel par/ nyin re zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ rdo rje'i slob ma ste/ dbang bskur ba thob pa la/ mkhas pa zhes pa rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ dkyil 'khor zhes pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga nyin re'am/ zla re'am/ lo re bya ba'i tshul bstan cing lung 'bogs par bya'o// ji ltar zhe na/ bshang gci sha'i bya ba dang*// zhes bya ba ste/ de la bshang gci smos pas ni bdud rtsi lnga yongs su gzung ngo*// sha smros pas ni rnam pa lnga yongs su gzung ngo*// bya ba dang zhes bya ba smros pas ni/

bza' ba dang btung bar bya ba ma yin pa rnams bzung ste/ bshang ba la sogs pa 'di dag dang*/ rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig dag gis zhes bya ba/ dbang po gnyis mnyam par sbyor ba dang*/ gar dang glu la sogs pa dag gis gdug pa thams cad gdul bar bya'o// zhes bya bar dgongs so// bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pas bza' ba la nyer bar spyod pa'i dus su yid ches pa brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ sngags rnams zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sngags thams cad kyi dang por gyur pa yi ge oṃ sngags sbyar ba rtogs par bya ba la bsgom na de ma thag tu mngon sum du 'bar bar 'gyur ro// zhes bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i skyes bu chen po ste/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to// zhes bshad pa ltar/ sbyang rtogs sbar gsum nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin grub nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i kun spyod rnams mdzad du gsol/ khyed lung sde snod gsum 'chad shes shing*/ mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud phyug pa'i dge bshes yin pas/ gzhan gang byed rang gi'ang mi chog lags/ slad ma myur du mjal nas/ slob dpon shākya 'od kyis 'dul 'dzin rnams kyi bsad sha bza' ru mi btub pa sogs kyi/ chos kyi bka' mchid bgro bar smon// rgyal kyi zla ba'i nyer gsum la/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod nas phul ba dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ // ༄// nyag re gsang sngags la springs pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i gling nas legs 'ongs shing*// bsam dpyod brtson pa'i byi dor gyis sbyangs pas// ting 'dzin bsgoms pa'i 'od zer stong 'bar ba// dpal ldan bla ma dbang gi rgyal por 'dud// nges med rgyal khams rgyu ba'i bsod snyoms pa// chos brgyad rnam rtog spangs pa'i bya bral ba// phyi ma byang chub re ba'i 'dod po che// kun dga' bzang por grags pa'i dge slong gis// rgyud sde'i khang bzangs rim gnyis nor gyis phyug

/rnam dag dam tshig sdom pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes// phrin las sgo bzhi'i gdul bya legs bskyangs pa// kun dga' gzhon nur grags la 'di skad glengs// khyod sku skabs gsum dbang po'i pho brang la// rnam g.yeng lha min dpung dang mi ldan par// blo gsal lha bu'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu// chos don bdud rtsi'i zas la spyod do zhes// ring nas 'ongs pa'i slob gnyis rgyud mangs kyi// pi wang sgra snyan sgrogs pa yang yang thos// khyad par lhag bsam dag pa'i chu gter las// legs 'khrungs 'bul ba'i me tog rnam mang dang*// dad pa'i blo gros nam mkha'i khyon yangs par// phrin yig nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa// pho nya rta bdun shing rtas rab drangs nas// dpal ldan sa skya'i skyed mos tshal du shar// de tshe kho bo'i yid kyi chu skyes tshal// dga' ba'i 'dab stong ldan par byas pa la// don gnyer rkang drug ldan pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// dge legs snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog par byed// 'dir yang kho bo'i dal 'byor lhun po la// rnam g.yeng mi mthun rlung gis mi g.yo zhing*// legs bshad rin chen khams dang ldan bzhin du// gdul bya gling bzhi'i dbus na bde bar gnas// shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob dus 'dir// rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed dgos pas// dam chos rin chen tshul bzhin 'chad pa la// yengs med brtson 'grus rtsom dang shes ldan dag /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir// tshig sgros dngos bstan tsam la ma zhen par// mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i gsang ba'i sgo phye nas// skabs don nyams su long dang shes ldan dag /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i sems 'dzin sogs// tshe 'di'i che thabs bsgrub pa'i blo spangs nas// gang na dam chos 'phel ba'i gnas rnams su// bshad sgrub tshul bzhin bsgrubs dang shes ldan dag /slad mar dpon slob so sor zhabs brtan zhing*// mkhas pa'i grwa slob tha grur rgyas pa dang*// tshe ring nad med thos bsam 'phel bzhin du// dngos sam yi ge'i ngos nas 'phrad par smon// khyed kyi dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa dang*// rgya chen 'bul ba'i rnam gzhag bskur ba sogs// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//

//shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la springs pa'o// ༈ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ mkhyen brtse nus ldan dkon mchog rnam gsum dang*// spyan ras gzigs la gus par phyag 'tshal te// sangs rgyas bstan la legs par rab byung nas// ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin la 'di skad smra// yon tan med la chen po'i go 'phang dag /nam yang 'thob pa'i go skabs mi srid bas// mdo dang rgyud 'grel man ngag che rnams la// 'bad pas sbyangs te mkhas par bya bar rigs/ 'di dang phyi ma'i mngon mtho nges legs kun// skyon med tshul khrims bsrung ba las byung zhing*// tshul khrims nyams la thar pa'i skabs med pas// bslab gsum mig 'bras bzhin du bskyang bar rigs// mar gyur 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral ba dang*// rang nyid thub dbang go 'phang thob 'dod na// kun rdzob pa dang don dam byang chub sems// legs par bsgoms pas bzang por bya bar rigs// brtson 'grus nyams la mkhas btsun bzang gsum dag /shar nub ri bzhin shin tu ring ba'i phyir// sngon gyi rgyal bas brtson 'grus khur bzhes ltar// nyin mtshan 'da' bas brtson 'grus brtsam par rigs// de ltar mkhas dang btsun dang bzang ba dang*// kun gyi grogs gyur brtson 'grus brtsam dgos zhes// zol med snying gi dkyil nas smras pa'i mthus// sdig spong dge ba'i las la brtson gyur cig /ces chos smra ba kun dga' bzang pos sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la springs pa'o// // ༄// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa la springs pa// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi gyong po kun// ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo la// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes par mtshan gsol ba'i// rtag par rang rgyud bsreg la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis gyong po'i kun spyod bstan pa'i tshe// ko skam shin tu mkhregs pa'ang zil gnon na// g.yag dang mdzo bas gyong ba smos ci 'tshal// de phyir khyod 'dra gyong po'i mchog tu gyur// e ma gang zhig rta bdun rgyal po 'di snyam du// khyod lta'i gyong po gling gzhan dag na yod med ces// nges par bya phyir 'bad pas gling gzhan kun bskor kyang*// nyid 'dra'i gyong po med par shes nas slar yang ni// shar ri'i rtse mor 'ongs nas 'di skad du// ba lang spyod sogs gling gzhan bskor byas kyang*// khyod dang mnyam pa'i gyong po ma rnyed na// khyod pas lhag pa srid pa ma yin zhes// ngo mtshar dad pa'i tsha zer 'phro bzhin du// ma phod sems kyis gling 'dir shar pa bzhin// zhes bshes gnyen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la bsngags pa sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs dang bral ba 'di ni/

kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o/// / ༄// dge slong bsod nams rin chen la springs pa// ༈ /dge slong bsod nams rin chen gyis/ 'dus pa'i glegs bam de/ me nyag dge bshes la/ da lan g.yar phor thong*/ de'i dge ba des/ khyed nyid sangs rgyas shog// /

༄// rgyal mo rong pa bkra shis dpal la gdams pa// ༈ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ rmad byung thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'gro ba'i rje// spyan ras gzigs la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// kun dga'i ming can shākya'i dge slong des// dad ldan bkra shis dpal la 'di skad smra// 'byor pa bcu ldan mi khom brgyad bral ba'i// lus rten dal 'byor phun tshogs thob dus 'dir// rnam dag tshul khrims lam gyi gzhir zung la// dam chos 'bad pas sgrubs shig bkra shis dpal// sdug bsngal rang bzhin bde ba'i skabs med pa'i// 'khor ba'i bde ba ltar snang la chags na// ci byas chos su 'gro ba mi srid pas// tshe 'di'i phun tshogs spongs shig bkra shis dpal// mtha' yas 'gro kun pha mar shes byas nas// byams dang snying rje kun rdzob byang sems dang*// spros kun bral ba'i don dam byang sems rnams// brtson 'grus drag pos sgoms shig bkra shis dpal// bde gshegs dkyil 'khor bsgom dang bzlas pa dang*// mchod dang gtor ma sbyin sreg bdag 'jug sogs// rgya chen zab mo'i thabs la 'bad bzhin du// brtson pas rdzogs rim sgoms shig bkra shis dpal// khyod kyis mtshan rtogs skyabs phyir bgrang phreng dang*// sdig pa zhi phyir dri med ras dkar dang*// bsod nams rgyas phyir bsngo ba'i bstan bcos rnams// bu khyod yul du 'gro ba'i skyes su 'bul// rang yul rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs su// skal bzang lha yi dbang po khyod song la// sna tshogs thabs tshul mthu stobs rdo rje des// bon ngan lha min bdud sde choms shig dang*// bde gshegs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang*// 'gro mang dam pa'i chos la sbyor ba dang*// rang gi 'dod don phun tshogs legs thob nas// bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur ro bkra shis dpal// zhes pa 'di rgyal mo rong pa bkra shis dpal la 'gro chos su/ rta'i lo dbo zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad la dpal sa skyar bris pa'o//

// ༄// blo bzang la gdams pa// ༈ /na maḥshrī gu ra we/ gang la brten na bslu ba med pa'i skyabs// 'dren pa dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas// 'jig rten chos brgyad spangs pa'i bya bral ba// blo gros bzang po de la 'di skad gdams// tshul gnas thos pa'i yon tan dang ldan nas// bsgrubs la brtson pa'i go cha cher bgos te// zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel pa'i lam// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsgom pa shin tu gces// khams gsum 'gro ba mtha' dag rang nyid kyi// pha ma lan mang byas shing phan btags phyir// de dag kun la snying rje'i blo bskyed nas// kun rdzob byang sems bsgom pa shin tu gces// las 'bras ngo bo bden par ma grub kyang*// ji snyed las kyi bag chags ma spangs par// rgyu 'bras bslu med tshul la yid ches pas// sdig spangs dge la 'bad pa shin tu gces/ dbon po rin rnam 'dir slob gnyer yang cher ma byung 'dug cing*/ chang yang dum pa 'thung gin yod pa 'dra bas re zhig nged kyi rjes la lo gnyis tsam cig phyin na drag gam zer ba byas pas/ khyed bgres pas 'gro mi nus zer bas ji ltar 'thad kyi gros mdzod/ mos gus kyi rten du ske rags chung ngu zla ba drug tsam bcings pa cig bdog 'bral med bla ma spyi bor bsgom pa dang*// khams gsum 'gro la snying rje bsgom pa dang*// rang sems spros dang bral bar bsgom pa gsum// blo bzang khyed kyis rgyun gyi nyams len mdzod// // ༄// nyag ra sangs rgyas grags la gdams pa// ༈ /rje bka' drin can gyi bla ma dang*// lha dkon mchog gsum la gus btud nas// pha kun dga'i ming can dge slong gis// bu sangs rgyas grags la 'di skad smra// rten dal 'byor rnyed pa shin tu dka'// de yun ring mi gnas nges par 'jig /nam 'jig tshe rgyu 'bras rjes su 'brang*// don 'di la soms dang sangs rgyas grags// khyod mi lus lan gcig thob dus 'dir// chos rnam dag bsgrubs la ma 'bad na// yul khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de// mi khyod kyis bzod dam sangs rgyas grags// rgyu 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba la// rkyen byang chub sems la rab brten nas// las brtson 'grus drag po bskyed dgos kyi// sems bzang bas mi phan sangs rgyas grags// gzhi so so thar ba'i sdom pa de// sems las su rung ba'i mchog yin te// phan bde dge bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin// de srog bzhin srungs shig sangs rgyas grags// lam byang chub sems dpa'i bslabs pa de// ma drin can sems can thams cad kyis// don bla med bsgrub pa'i thabs yin pas// de gces par zungs shig sangs rgyas grags// sngags rig 'dzin dam tshig sdom pa de// tshe 'di la sangs rgyas bsgrub 'dod na// don 'di las lhag pa gzhan med pas// de srog bzhin srungs shig sangs rgyas grags// khyod mdo khams stod nas 'dir 'ongs pa// chos kho na'i ched du ma gtogs pa// don gzhan la 'ongs ba ma yin pas// bu brtson 'grus bskyed cig sangs rgyas grags// glu de skad blangs pa'i dge ba des// don khyod kyi snying la rab zhugs nas// tshul 'bad rtsol drag po bskyed byas nas// don khyod kyi snying la zhugs par shog/

// ༄// dbon po rgyal mtshan dpal yum sras bcas la gdams pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ gang la brten na bslu med mchog thob cing*// sdug bsngal rgyu bcas 'joms pa'i skyabs cig po// rin chen dkon mchog gsum la gus btud nas// mi dbang yum sras bcas la 'di skad gsol// bde sdug 'byor rgud 'du 'bral la sogs pa// 'gro ba kun la yong gi cig la min// des na chos tshul dgongs pa'i mi dbang khyod// mya ngan zug rngu spongs la dam chos sgrubs// deng dus mi 'dod rkyen ngan sna tshogs kyis// lus sems sdug bsngal che la sbyar ba 'di// sngon byas las kyi 'bras bu smin pas na// phyi ma bde bar 'gyur zhes dga' bar sgoms// phan mang btags pa'i 'khor gyis 'di phod ni// sngon gyi las las 'gyod pa gzhan ci yod/ des na dgra gnyen bar ma thams cad la// byang sems mnyam par sgoms shig mi dbang dag /rnam mang skye ba'i lan chags 'ded byed pa'i// sdug pa'i bu mchog snying la zhen pa de// mi rtag 'gyur na'ang 'dus byas thams cad kyi// mtshan nyid de ltar mkhyen mdzod sbyin bdag mo// mya ngan sdug bsngal brgya phrag sna tshogs kyis// lus sems gdungs kyang gzhan la mi phan zhing*// rang nyid sdug la dgos pa med shes nas// lus sems sdug bsngal spongs shig sbyin bdag mo// slad nas sku tshe lhun po ltar brtan zhing*// 'khor mang rgya mtsho bzhin du rab rgyas la// grags snyan nyi zla bzhin du rnam gsal nas// dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par gyur// //shubhaṃ// // ༄// ya tshe rgyal bo hasti rā dza yab yum sras bcas la gdams pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ sku gsum mngon gyur rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// theg gsum don ston chags bral dam pa'i chos// bslab gsum rnam dag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// sgo gsum g.yo med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs kyis rjes bzung zhing*// bde gshegs bstan la mi phyed dad pa can// dam chos smra ba'i dge slong sa skya pa// blo ldan kun dga' bzang po zhes bya bas// sngon dge'i bsod nams stobs las grub pa'i lus// rnam dag rigs dang cho 'brang ches mtho zhing*// 'khor dang longs spyod dbang phyug phun tshogs pas// rgyal srid des pas skyong ba'i dpal yon can// chos kyi rgyal po hasti rā dza dang*// de sras thu bo a hru rā dza dpal// btsun mo dam pa dza gad smal rnams la// dge ba'i sems kyis chos kyi skyes 'di gleng*// khyed kyis lhag bsam dag pas bskur ba yis// sna tshogs g.yos su sbyar ba'i zhal zas dang*// gdan dang rgyab yol chos gos rgyu la sogs// rings nas 'ongs pa'i pho nyas legs par 'phrod// rnam mang dge ba 'di dang dge tshogs gzhan// ji snyed bsags rnams gcig tu bsdus byas nas// thub dbang shākya'i go 'phang dam pa de// mar gyur 'gro bas myur du thob phyir bsngo// khyed kyi da lta'i stobs dang bsod nams rnams// byed po gzhan gyis byas pa ma yin zhing*// ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa'ang ma yin gyi// sngon gyi dge ba kho na'i rgyu yin pas// de phyir dge ba bsgrub la brtson par mdzod// ston pa 'khor ba'i 'dam las ma grol zhing*// bstan pa nyon mongs dri ma skyed byed pa// tshangs dang khyab 'jug dbang phyug la sogs dang*// mu stegs byed dang kla klo'i chos lugs rnams// rnam pa kun du dug bzhin spong bar mdzod// khyad par khyed kyis bskyangs pa'i rgyal khams na// lha rnams mchod phyir bya dang ra lug sogs// srog gi mchod sbyin byed pa yod ces thos// 'di dag chos rgyal khyod kyis dgag par mdzod// 'gro ba bsad pas dges pa'i lha de yi// rgyud la snying rje chen po ga la yod// snying rje med pa'i lha la mchod byas na// de yi 'bras bu ngan song las gzhan ci// de ltar mkhyen nas mi dbang khyed nyid kyis// srog gi mchod sbyin rang gis byed pa dang*// byed du 'jug dang gzhan gyis byed pa sogs// thams cad rnam pa kun du spong bar mdzod// skyabs gnas mthar thug dkon mchog rin po che// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// skyabs su song na sdug bsngal kun zhi zhing*// dge legs thob par nges pas skyabs 'gro mdzod// grong dang tshong dus 'gro mang 'tshogs dbus su// ston pa bla med shākya'i rgyal po dang*// rin chen dkon mchog rnam pa gsum gyi mtshan// skye bo kun gyis thos slad bsgrags par mdzod// sngon gyi ya tshe'i chos rgyal che rnams kyis// bod yul bstan pa'i 'byung khungs mkhas pa'i gling*// dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po der// theg chen chos sgra sgrogs gnas chos khri'i steng*// rin chen gser gyi thog phub rgya che ba// gser bzang tog gis brgyan pa phul ba yang*// dus ring dbang gis rnying zhing zhig par gyur// 'di dag sngon bzhin gsos na cis mi legs// longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med shes nas// dge slong bram ze chos ldan skyes bu dang*// phongs dang nad can mgon med gyur rnams la// re ba med pa'i sbyin pa rgya chen mdzod// bran dang g.yog sogs 'gro ba 'di dag kun// rang gi pha ma yang yang byas nges shing*// phan bde bskyed pa'i drin bzang bsam yas phyir// byams shing brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyang du gsol// rgyal srid ched du phan tshun rtsod pa dang*// dmag dang g.yul ngo 'gyed pa la sogs pa// thams cad mi dge'i bya bar rab mkhyen nas// bag yod spyod pas rang srid bskyang du gsol// mi dge spyad las 'bras bu ngan song dang*// dge ba'i las las byang chub gsum thob pa'i// bslu med las 'bras tshul bzhin rtogs byas nas// sdig spong dge ba bsgrub la brtson par rigs// de ltar 'doms pa'i yi ge'i rten tsam du// rgyud bzhin mkhas pas bris pa'i bsrung 'khor gsum// rab gnas cho gas brtan par byas pa dang*// dar mdud sngags kyis btab pa 'di dag 'bul// slad nas rgyal po yab sras 'khor bcas rnams// tshe ring nad med dbang phyug phun tshogs shing*// sangs rgyas bstan la mngon par dad pa dang*// bla med byang chub dam pa thob gyur cig/

// ༄// ya tshe blon po la gdams pa// ༈ /tshe 'di'i bya bas phyi ma don che bas// 'gro kun pha mar shes nas bskyangs pa dang*// rgyal ba'i bstan la dad pa bskyed pa dang*// mi dge'i bya ba mtha' dag spong bar mdzod// //dad pa can a ya dbang phyug bkra shis kyi zangs bum chen po klu gtor gyi sman dang bcas pa bla ma pas 'phrod pas sems spro/ skabs don/ mi rtag myur du 'chi bar nges pas na// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*// khams gsum 'gro ba pha mar shes byas nas// sdig spong dge ba bsgrubs la brtson par mdzod// dad pa'i rten tsam du srung mdud gcig bdog /tshes bzang po la phul ba dge/ // ༄// thar pa ye shes la springs pa'o// ༈ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ dad pa dang dge ba'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa/ dpon rgan thar pa ye shes pa/ sku khams bzang zhing dge ba'i bya ba la brtson pa'i thad nas/ gsung yig rten bcas 'phrod pas rjes su yi rangs/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ 'dir bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa/ rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rnams kyi gsung rab rnams grub nas zhu dag dang*/ rab gnas sogs legs par mthar phyin nas/ de phyogs su spyan drangs nas byon yod pas thugs dga' spro rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ nyams len gyi rim pa'i chos shig dgos zer ba/ mdor bsdus te brjod na// ༈ //na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ phun tshogs dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgo gcig po// dpal ldan bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsgom// khams gsum 'gro ba pha mar shes byas nas// byams dang snying rje rgyun chad med par bsgom// bdag bde gzhan la sbyin zhing gzhan rgyud kyi// sdug bsngal mtha' dag rang gis len par bsgom// dkar nag las 'bras bslu ba med shes nas// sdig spang dge ba bsgrubs la brtson par mdzod// de ltar byas na sbyin bdag dad pa can// thar pa ye shes khyed kyang lam bzang la// bar chad med par zhugs nas byang chub che// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'gyur// gnas skabs gang du tshe ring nad med cing*// longs spyod phun tshogs bkra shis dge legs ldan// sa phyogs dge zhing lo tog rgyas pa dang*// rmad byung dam chos phyogs bcur rgyas par 'gyur// zhes pa e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod nas phul ba'o// dad pa'i rten du nged kyi gon 'phro'i cha rog gnyis phul ba bdog

'di phyogs kyi rgyu mtshan rnams bla ma ba la gsal/ stag lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga la ri khrod nas phul ba dge legs 'phel// // ༄// slob dpon bzod pa la bstod pa'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ thub dbang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa/ mkhas mchog brgyud par bcas pa'i phrin las las// legs grub rtsod pa'i dbang phyug bzod pa dpal// phyogs las rnam rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phun tshogs dal 'byor don yod bya phyir du// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs// gsung rab dgongs 'grel bcas la nyin mtshan du// thos dang bsam pas dus 'das khyod la 'dud// kun mkhyen gnyis pa rong ston chos rje sogs// bcu phrag gnyis dang bdun gyis lhag pa yi// yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen gus bsten nas// rgya chen chos kyi mdzod du gyur la 'dud// 'dul ba mngon pa pha rol phyin la sogs// zab mo'i sde snod thams cad thugs chud nas// ma nor legs par bshad pa'i char chen gyis// gdul bya'i blo gros rgyas par mdzad la 'dud// kun las btus dang sde bdun rigs gter sogs// rtog ge'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag legs rtogs nas// yang dag rig pa'i snang bas gsung rab gyi// grangs nges tshul bzhin byed pa khyod la 'dud// gang gi rig pa seng ge'i gad rgyangs kyis// smra ngan wa tshogs mtha' dag pham byas nas// yin lugs chos kyi snang bas phyogs kun tu// rab 'byams gdul bya rgyas par mdzad la 'dud// zhing gzhan gshegs tshe zhing 'dir nam mkha'i khams// grangs med rje btsun sgrol ma'i skus gang nas// bu khyod bde ba can du song ces pa'i// lung bstan byang chub brnyes pa khyod la 'dud// sku gdung zhugs la zhen tshe 'ja' 'od dang*// me tog char gyis 'gro kun dwang bar mdzad// lha sku'i tshogs dang ring bsrel bsam yas kyis// dad ldan tshogs gnyis rgyas mdzad khyod la 'dud// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i bsod nams des// gdul byar gyur rnams rjes su 'dzin pa dang*// kun mkhyen gnyis pa rong ston chos kyi rje// sku tshe brtan zhing phrin las rgyas gyur cig

/yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzod chen phyogs las rnam rgyal la bstod pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// // ༄// phyi'i gtam bshad legs po cig bzhugs so// ༈ /gang zhig la gus pas brten cing skyabs su song na/ ngan 'gro dang srid zhi'i g.yengs pa mtha' dag la skyob cing*/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la sbyor bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ lhar bcas 'gro ba ma lus pa'i gtsug rgyan dang 'dren pa dam par bzhugs shing*/ de dag gi rten yang*/ spyir rgyal ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' dag na bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs shing*/ bye brag tu yang*/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi gtsug lag khang rnams na yang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten gsum ngo mtshar ba rnams kyi drung na/ sna tshogs yid 'ong mchod pa'i tshogs dang bcas te/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa bzhugs pa lags/ de dag gi skyabs kyi 'og nas/ mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid bla ma pas gtso mdzad/ phun sum tshogs pa'i 'phags pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung*/ mi che bas gral gyi gong mnan/ yon tan mkhyen pas gral gyi zur brgyan/ bya ba byed pa rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' brten te/ 'di ltar 'tshog pa gdan gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad kyang*/ dkar ba las kyi gzhi bzung*/ dag pa smon lam gyi mtshams sbyar te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la nye bar thob pa'i chos dang dam tshig zab mos sbrel bas na/ 'brel ba zab/ tshogs pa sbyin bdag gi rgyud la tshogs gnyis rgyas pa'i thabs la 'tshog pas na 'tshogs pa yang bzang*/ lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ spyir khams gsum gyi sems can/

dus gsum gyi nad kyis gzir ba rnams la/ skyob pa shākya'i rgyal po de nyid shin tu bka' drin che/ sgos dzam+bū gling pa rnams la/ 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ mchog gnyis dang brgyad du grags pa rnams bka' drin che/ bod kha ba can pa rnams la sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ lo paṇa skyes mchog khyad par can rnams shin tu bka' drin che/ dus phyis kyi 'gro ba phal mo che rnams la/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rin po che rim par byon pa rnams dang*/ chos rgyud 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams bka' drin che/ mchod yul du zhabs yang par byon pa rnams/ sbyin pa'i bdag po la shin tu bka' drin che lags/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ 'di ltar/ zhal mngon sum gyur pa'i bla ma dang*/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ zhal zas tsha ba'i bsnyen cing bkur bas nye bar mchod/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten rnam par dag pa dang*/ gang la gang 'os kyi 'bul ba/ so so'i phyag tu gral 'gyed kyi dngos po dang bcas pa bsgrub pa'i skabs kyi don/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar rgyas su bya ba dang*/ bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku'i rim gror yang dmigs shing*/ khyad par du yang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po rang nyid kyi sku'i rim gror dmigs nas bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bsgrub par gda' bas/ dge ba rnam par dag pa mdzad par shin tu rjes su yi rang*/ slan chad kyi dbang du bgyis nas gong ma yon mchod chab srid brtan/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde zhing skyid pa'i thad nas/ bkra shis shing chos 'phel gyi bya ba 'di lta bu la yang yang zhal 'dzom bgyid par smon/ dge 'dun rnams kyi gtor ma'i byin rlabs/ theg pa chen po'i mdo bsngo ba rnams rim pa bzhin thugs la 'dogs par zhu//

༄// nang gi yas gtam bzhugs so// ༈ /bde chen 'od gsal chos sku'i nam mkha' yangs par/ zung 'jug longs sku'i dkyil 'khor rgyas nas/ phrin las dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa'i tsha zer 'phros pas/ 'gro ba rnams kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa sel bar byed pa'i bdag nyid/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ skyabs gnas rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ lhar bcas 'gro ba ma lus pa'i gtsug rgyan dang 'dren pa dam par bzhugs shing*/ de dag gi rten yang spyir u rgyan la sogs pa rdo rje theg pa'i zhing khams rnams na bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs shing*/ bye brag tu yang*/ snod dag pa gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud dag pa lha'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i rang re'i dkyil 'khor khang pa 'di nyid na yang*/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi thog drangs/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten ngo mtshar ba rnams kyi drung na/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i tshogs dang bcas te/ bka' sdod dam pa dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa srung ma gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa bzhugs pa lags/ de dag gi skyabs kyi 'og nas rgyud sde'i khang bzangs rim gnyis kyi nor gyis phyug cing*/ dam tshig sdom pa'i rgyan gyis mdzad pa bla ma pas gtso mdzad/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung*/ mi che ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis gral gyi gong mnan/ yon tan mkhyen pa'i sngags 'chang rnams kyis gral gyi zur brgyan/ bya ba byed pa'i las kyi rdo rje he ru ka'i nga rgyal can rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' brten te/ 'di ltar tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa thams cad kyang dkar ba las kyi gzhi bzung*/ dag pa smon lam gyi mtshams sbyar te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las/ dbang brgyud man ngag zab mo rnams nye bar thob pa'i rdo rje'i spun du gyur pas 'brel pa shin tu zab/

'tshog pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba thun mong ma yin pa la 'tshogs pas na shin tu bzang*/ lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ spyir 'dod khams kyi sems can 'dod chags rigs bzhis gzir ba rnams la rgyud sde bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor te/ sku bzhi'i go 'phang la sbyor bar mdzad pas/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid shin tu bka' drin che/ sgos rgyud sde zab mo rnams kyis drang nges 'byed pa la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa'i slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa la sogs pa grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon rnams bka' drin che/ bod kha ba can pa rnams la rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi bsgyur zhing bshad srol 'dzugs pa'i lo paṇa skyes mchog khyad par can rnams bka' drin che/ bye brag tu chos rgyud 'di pa la rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa thams cad bka' drin che/ mchod yul du byon pa rnams sbyin pa'i bdag po la shin tu bka' drin che lags/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ 'di ltar zhal mngon sum du gyur pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams la/ thabs shes rab kyi rdzas khyad par can gyis nye bar mchod/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten dang bcas pa bsgrub pa'i skabs kyi don/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su bya ba dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu thams cad kyi sku'i rim gro la yang dmigs shing*/ khyad par du/ dus khyad par can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus nyi shu dgu la/ srung ma khyad par can dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma nar mar 'bul ba'i rgyun la dmigs nas/ sbyin bdag pa rnams pas bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bsgrub par gda' bas/ dge ba rnam dag mdzad pa shin tu rjes su yi rangs/

phyin chad kyi dbang du bgyis na/ gong ma yon mchod chab srid brtan/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde zhing skyid pa'i thad nas/ gsang sngags kyi kun spyod zab mo 'di lta bu la yang yang zhal 'dzom bgyid par smon/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis lhag ma'i gtor ma/ rdo rje'i klu/ bkra shis kyi byin 'bebs pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar bsngo ba rnams rim pa bzhin thugs la 'dogs par zhu// ༈ //na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ phun tshogs mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer stong ldan pas// thub bstan pad+ma'i tshal brgya 'byed mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// rgya chen smon lam 'grub par mdzad du gsol// bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams// sbyin dang tshul khrims bsgom par legs bsdus nas// mar gyur 'gro ba byang chub thob don du// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog thob shog /gnas skabs kun tu rigs bzang 'byor par ldan// dam pas rjes bzung rnam dag khrims kyis mdzes// rigs kyi nus pa gzhan las mi dman pa'i// chos ldan dal 'byor lus bzang thob par shog /sbyor ba'i sngon nas snying rje che ba dang*// dkon mchog la mos gzhan gyi gnod pa bzod// dge ba yang dag spyod la dad pa sogs// rnam dag rigs kyi yon tan ldan par shog /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral phyir du// skyabs kyi dam pa mchog gsum rin chen la// bcos med dad pa chen pos dus kun tu// skyabs su 'gro zhing rjes su 'jug par shog/ // ༄// gser 'od dam pa las btus pa'i smon lam bzhugs so// ༈ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten mi ring sangs rgyas myur bar shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston gyur cig /sems can sdug bsngal mang gzir thar byed shog /stobs bcas sder bcas bdud las rgyal gyur cig

/chos kyi 'khor lo dge ba bskor bar shog /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab gnas gyur cig /bdud rtsi'i chu yis sems can tshim byed shog /ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal bas rdzogs pa ltar// pha rol phyin drug bla med rdzogs par shog /nyon mongs bcom zhing sdug bsngal sel gyur cig /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug zhi byed shog /tshe rabs brgya dang tshe rabs bye ba stong*// bdag ni rtag tu tshe rabs dran par shog /thub pa'i dbang po rtag tu dran gyur cig /de dag rnams kyis gsung rgya ches thos shog /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// rtag tu sangs rgyas 'grog pa rnyed par shog /sdig pa'i las rnams rnam par spong gyur cig /dge ba'i 'byung gnas dge rnams spyod par shog /zhing rnams kun na srog chags thams cad kyang*// 'jig rten dag na sdug bsngal kun zhir gyur// sems can dbang po ma tshang yan lag nyams// de kun de ring dbang po tshang bar shog /gang dag nad btab nyam chung lus nyams dang*// phyogs bcu dag na skyabs med gyur pa rnams// de kun myur du nad las thar gyur cig /nad med stobs dang dbang po rnyed par shog /gang dag rgyal po chom rkun dgras bsdigs bsad zug dang*// sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs brgya yis phongs gyur pa// sems can nyam thag gyur zhing sdug bsngal de dag kun// 'jig tshogs mi bzad brgya po de las thar gyur cig /gang dag rgyal po chom rkun dgras bsdigs bas da thug dang*// sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs brgya yis phongs gyur pa// sems can nyam thag gyur zhing sdug bsngal de dag kun// 'jig tshogs mi bzad brgya po las thar gyur cig /gang dag bsdigs shing bcings pas bcings gzir ba// phongs pa sna tshogs dag na gnas gyur cing*// nyon mongs stong phrag du mas dkrugs nas kyang*// 'jigs pa mi bzad mya ngan sna tshogs rnyed// de dag thams cad bcings las grol gyur cig

/brdeg pa rnams ni brdeg las thar par shog /bsad pa rnams kyang srog dang ldan gyur cig /phongs gyur thams cad 'jigs pa med par shog /sems can gang dag bkres sred skom gyis gzir// de dag zas skom sna tshogs rnyed par shog /long bas gzugs rnams sna tshogs mthong gyur cig /'on pas yid 'ong skra rnams thos par shog /gcer bu rnams kyis sna tshogs gos rnyed gyur// sems can dbul pos gter rnams rnyed par shog /nor 'bru rin chen sna tshogs mang po yis// sems can thams cad bde dang ldan par shog /gang yang sdug bsngal tshor bas gnod ma gyur// sems can thams cad blta na sdug pa dang*// gzugs bzang mdzes shing tshul du shis par shog /rtag tu bde ba du ma sog gyur cig /yid kyi zas skom rab 'byor bsod snyoms dag /bsams ma thag tu de dag grub gyur cig /rdza rnga cang te'u pi wang sgra snyan dang*// chu mig mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka dang*// gser gyi pad+ma ut+pal 'dab ma can// zas skom gos nor mu tig nor bu dbyig /rgyan ser rin chen sna tshogs bai ḍū r+ya// de dag bsams ma thag tu grub gyur cig /'jig rten gang na'ang sdug bsngal sgra ma 'byung*// sems can gcig kyang mi 'phrod mthong ma gyur// de dag thams cad kha dog rgya chen dang*// phan tshun 'dir ni 'od byed gyur par shog /mi yi 'jig rten phun sum tshogs gang yod// de dag bsam par skye bar de dag gyur// bsam pa thams cad bsam ma thag tu yang*// bsod nams 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs par shog /spos dang phreng ba dag dang byug pa dang*// gos dang phye ma me tog sna tshogs dang*// ljon shing dag las dus gsum 'bab par shog /sems can de dag len cing dgar gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa bsam yas thams cad dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dang*// rdul bral dri med brten pa'i chos la yang*// phyogs bcu rnams su mchod pa byed par shog

/'gro ba dman pa thams cad spong gyur cig /mi khom brgyad po dag las 'das par shog /dal ba brgyad po dam pa mchog thob 'gyur// rtag tu sangs rgyas 'grog pa thob par shog /rtag tu mthon po'i rigs su skye bar shog /nor dang 'bru yi mdzod rnams 'byung gyur cig /snyan dang grags pa gzugs dang kha dog gis// bskal pa du mar legs par brgyan par shog /bud med thams cad rtag tu phor gyur te// dpa' zhing brtul phod mkhas shing gsal bar shog /de kun rtag tu byang chub phyir spyod 'gyur// pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod par shog /phyogs bcu dag na rin chen shing dbang drung*// sangs rgyas bde bzhugs rin chen bai ḍūr+ya'i// khri la bzhugs pa dag ni mthong gyur cig /chos bstan pa yang de dag thos par shog /bdag gis sdig pa'i las rnams bsgrub pa ni// srid pa nyam ngar sngon chad gang bsgrubs pa// sdig las gang dag mi 'dod 'bras thob pa// de dag thams cad ma lus zad gyur cig /sems can gang dag sdig par bcings gnas kun// 'khor ba'i zhags pa'i thag pas dam bcings pa// shes rab lag gis bcings pa 'grol bar shog /sdug bsngal rnams las thar 'gyur thob gyur cig /sems can gang dag dzam+bū'i gling 'di dang*// gang dag 'jig rten khams ni gzhan rnams na// bsod nams sna tshogs zab mo rnam byed pa// de dag kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bsgrub pa yi// bdag ni rjes su yi rang bsod nams des// bdag gi smon 'grub 'bras bu yod par shog /byang chub rdul bral bla med thob gyur cig /smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa las/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos btus pa'o// // ༄// dril bu pa'i lus dkyil gyi bshad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi dka' ba'i gnas kyi mtha' rnam par dpyad pa/

'khrul 'joms nyi ma'i 'od zer ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gsung nyin byed 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i snying gi mun bsal nas// ma nor lam bzang snang mdzad pa'i// ye shes mtshan can bla mar 'dud// e ma gang zhig tshad med zhal ldan de nyid gsum gyi spyan rgyas shing*// rten 'brel bcu gnyis phyag gi pad+ma sna tshogs mtshon chas nyer mdzes la// phyag rgya drug gis nye bar sgeg cing 'gyur med mgo bo'i do shal can// brkyang bskum zhabs kyis 'jigs byed snying gar rol pas gar mdzad de yis skyongs// zab yangs bde mchog rgyud sde'i chu gter las// smin grol yid bzhin nor bu legs blangs nas// skal ldan gdul bya'i bsam pa tshim mdzad pa'i// grub pa'i dbang phyug dril bu pa la 'dud// 'di na rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud sde la// kho bo'i bla ma mkhyen brtse'i yon tan mdzod// snyigs dus bstan pa'i sgron me'ang 'khrul gyur na// sgra phyir 'brang ba gzhan rnams smos ci dgos// de phyir bdag blo ma rgyud pad+mo'i gnyen// don gnyer blo gros pad tshal rgyas byed pa// legs bshad rta bdun ldan 'di shar bas na// mun pa'i lus dkyil gling gzhan 'gro ba'i rigs// 'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i rim pa la tshul gsum ste/ phyi dkyil rkyang pa/ phyi nang sbrag ste/ nang dkyil rkyang par bsgom pa'o// dang po ni slob dpon laṅka rgyal bzang gi sgrub thabs dang*/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i rdo rje phreng bar bshad pa'i bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum dang*/ slob dpon mai tri pa'i lha bcu gsum ma lta bu'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ phyi dkyil dang por bsgoms nas/ nang lus dkyil rjes su bsgom pa grub chen lu hi pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa lta bu dang*/ nang dkyil dang por bsgoms nas phyi dkyil rjes la bsgom pa slob dpon byang chub rdo rje'i lugs lta bu dang*/

phyi nang gnyis gcig char du bsgom pa grub chen nag po spyod pa'i lugs lta bu ste rgyas par bsgom pa'i tshul gsum dang*/ ma ṇi ka shrī'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs lta bu bsdus te bsgom pa'i tshul rnams so// gsum pa ni/ grub chen rdo rje dril bu pas rgyud kyi sbas pa'i don gzhung du bkod pa lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs su grags pa 'di yin te/ 'di'i dka' ba'i gnas dpyad pa la gsum/ phyi dkyil tsam las lus dkyil khyad par du 'phags tshul/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i lus dkyil de sangs rgyas kyis gsung tshul/ de'i don gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ byin rlabs myur bas khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye bas khyad par du 'phags pa'o// dang po ni rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ yul 'di dag gi bu mo gang*// dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma// de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te// yid kyis shugs kyi 'jug pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhir bskyed pa'i lus dkyil gyi lha rnams la phyi'i yul nyer bzhi na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dngos yin par bsgoms pas/ yul de dag na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi byin rlabs shin tu myur bar 'jug pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yul 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang*// rtsa'i gzugs kyis rnam par gnas zhes nang gi rtsa nyer bzhi nas rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi ngo bor gsungs pas de ltar du bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i yid la 'jug pa yin no// de lta bu'i rnal 'byor de yang lus dkyil la yod kyi/ phyi dkyil rkyang pa la med pas/ nang gi rnal 'byor 'di mchog tu shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pas ni snang ba lha'i 'khor lo 'char zhing yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can la sems gtad pa sogs las bde ba chen po'i ye shes cung zad bskyed nus kyang*/
